create.name: Carmen Warrington
create.bio:
Carmen Warrington is an English-born Australian meditation guide, sound practitioner and writer whose calm speaking voice has carried her guided meditations to listeners around the world. Her family emigrated to Australia when she was a child; she studied at university in Hobart, trained as an actor at NIDA and worked for years in Sydney theatre, film, television and radio before turning more fully to meditation. She took up Brahma Kumaris (Raja Yoga) meditation in 1984 and still practises it, and she later helped write a free online introduction to that practice.

Since the 2000s she has written and recorded many spoken meditation albums, including an eight-part series made for ABC Music with her partner, the percussionist David Jones, who also plays alongside her in concerts. She has offered guided meditations on Insight Timer since 2015. Her soundbaths, held since 2000 for individuals, groups, studios and workplaces across Victoria, use crystal and Tibetan singing bowls, gongs, chimes and her own voice, and invite listeners to lie down and simply listen. She is the author of two short books of daily affirmations, Today I Will... and Today I Am..., published by Hachette Australia, and she also works as a civil celebrant.

books.title: Today I Will...
books.author: Carmen Warrington
books.description: Her first book, a small collection of daily intentions and reflections, first published by Lothian Books and reissued by Hachette Australia in 2016.

books.title: Today I Am...
books.author: Carmen Warrington
books.description: A companion book of short daily affirmations, first published as Who Am I? with illustrations by Linda Franklin and reissued under its new title in 2017.

courses.title: Soundbath with Carmen
courses.description: Bookable soundbaths for one person, a small group at home, a yoga studio, a workplace or a conference. She brings crystal and Tibetan singing bowls, gongs and chimes, and guests sit or lie down to listen.

free_resources.title: Carmen Warrington on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free guided meditations on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: The Sanctuary Experience
free_resources.description: A set of free guided meditations she voiced and scored for a Brahma Kumaris community project, made to offer a quiet, settled space to people living through emergencies.

free_resources.title: Learn Meditation Online
free_resources.description: A free online introductory course in Brahma Kumaris Raja Yoga meditation that she co-wrote with Annie Waltham and for which she recorded some of the guided commentaries.
